page.layout: One page of running text, one column. Running head at top centre: "ANNOTATIONES." Page number at top right. Signature "x 5" and catchword "Et" at the foot.

main_text.p: VÆ qui defcendunt.) Quia videbat pro-pheta quofdam urgere, ut confilium de implo-randa ope Aegyptiorum perficeretur: ideo pluribus verbis in tales agit, & diligenter inculcat, quas ob caufas confilium eorum non fit admittendum. Ante omnia igitur generali propofitione omnibus illis comminatur,qui confilium illud tantopere probabant,de-inde ipfe pluribus rationibus id confutat.
Et qui innitǔtur,&c.) Prima ratio à qualita-te peccati feu criminis. Eft enim incredulitas & diffi-dentia deteftabilis, quando plus fidunt ope humana quàm ope Dei.

Qui cum fapientissimus.) Secunda ratio, à præ[?]sentia sapientiæ divinæ præsapientia humanæ. Deus melius novit quid expediat, quàm illi sapientes (sua opinione) consiliarij. Et per suam sapientiam Deus adduxit malum, & constituit obsidionem Ierusalem, constituit eiusdem liberationem, atq; hostium exitium: & quæ per suam sapientiam semel decreuerit, ea non auferet, neq; mutabit. Denique per suam sapientiam surget contra domum malignantium, hoc est, contra omnes in genere, qui de ipsius ope diffidunt, ac voluntati ipsius suadent contraria. Hæc omnia pro sapientiæ divinæ effectibus atq; officijs constituuntur, contra quos effectus nihil valent, quæcunque humana sapientia machinatur.

page.notes: Long s is printed as f in places ("fuam", "confilium"); transcribed as s per rules, with the printed spelling otherwise kept. The second line "ANNOTATIONES." in small spaced capitals below the running head is treated as part of the running head and not a heading. The page number is read as "319", but the first digit is faint and could be "319" or "219" [?]. The word "præsentia" is doubtful: the scan reads "prasiantia" [?]. The breve over "innitǔtur" is uncertain. The initial "V" is a large decorative initial joined to "Æ".
